name: Push-Up Mastery
subtitle: Build pressing mechanics from incline to explosive & archer variations

stages.title: Incline Push-Ups
stages.tips: Keep shoulders depressed and body in a rigid plank.

stages.title: Strict Floor Push-Ups
stages.tips: Chest touches floor; full scapular protraction at top.

stages.title: Diamond Push-Ups
stages.tips: Elbows track close to ribs; lock triceps cleanly.

stages.title: Archer Push-Ups
stages.tips: Keep assisting arm straight while lowering toward working side.

name: Pull-Up & Muscle-Up
subtitle: Progress from scapular activation to strict bar muscle-up

stages.title: Scapular Pull-Ups
stages.tips: Depress shoulder blades with locked elbows.

stages.title: Strict Pull-Ups
stages.tips: Dead hang start to chin clearly over bar.

stages.title: Chest-to-Bar Pull-Ups
stages.tips: Drive elbows down and back explosively.

stages.title: Strict Bar Muscle-Up
stages.tips: Pull high to sternum and transition chest forward over bar.

name: Freestanding Handstand
subtitle: Develop wrist control, hollow alignment, and vertical balance

stages.title: Pike Hold (Feet Elevated)
stages.tips: Stack hips directly over wrists.

stages.title: Chest-to-Wall Handstand
stages.tips: Push tall through shoulders and tuck ribs.

stages.title: Wall Toe-Pull Balance Drills
stages.tips: Use finger pressure to catch overbalance gently.

stages.title: Freestanding Handstand Hold
stages.tips: Maintain quiet hollow line with micro-adjustments at wrists.

name: Full Planche
subtitle: Condition bicep tendons and anterior deltoids for horizontal balance

stages.title: Scapular Push-Up Plank
stages.tips: Hold maximum protraction with locked elbows.

stages.title: Pseudo Planche Lean
stages.tips: Lean shoulders past wrists without bending arms.

stages.title: Tuck Planche Hold
stages.tips: Keep hips level with shoulders.

stages.title: Straddle Planche Hold
stages.tips: Extend legs wide while maintaining posterior pelvic tilt.

name: Front Lever
subtitle: Master horizontal lat depression and anti-extension core tension

stages.title: Active Dead Hang
stages.tips: Keep shoulders depressed away from ears.

stages.title: Tuck Front Lever Hold
stages.tips: Lock elbows and keep back parallel to floor.

stages.title: Advanced Tuck Front Lever
stages.tips: Open hip angle to 90 degrees with flat back.

stages.title: Full Front Lever Hold
stages.tips: Squeeze glutes and push down hard on the bar.
